name: word-roller-mask-slide
title: Word Roller Mask Slide
description: A huge word is wiped away from the right by the next word in an accent colour, which slides in behind a moving mask; a thin progress line under the word fills over each cycle.
useWhen: Uppercase words that change on a hard, graphic wipe (inspire, imagine, innovate, impact).
A title card where the incoming word should arrive in a different colour.
avoidWhen: Soft, blurred or bouncy swaps: use word-roller-blur or word-roller-scale-bounce.
Mixed-length words where the width jump distracts.
author: lifeprompt-team

variables.label: Words
variables.description: Words in order, separated by commas. The last one is where it settles.

variables.label: Lead-in
variables.description: Small caps line above the word.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Size of the word in pixels. A wide word shrinks to fit the frame.

variables.label: Incoming color
variables.description: Color of the word while it slides in, and of the progress line.

variables.label: Frames per word
variables.description: How long each word is shown, in 30 fps frames.

variables.label: Background
variables.description: Fill behind the text. Use transparent to lay the block over your own footage.
